Is this a festival venue?\nThere is a huge cherry blossom tree but...\nIt's not blooming at all...
*sigh* Not again...\nWhat should I do...
Oh, you enjoy watching such a poor tree?\nThis might be some kind of fate to meet you here.\nCould you give us a hand for me?
Surprised?\nActually, I'm the spirit of this tree.\nI'm Sherry. Nice to meet you.
I'm kinda in trouble... Can you see that?\nI don't know what that is but it comes down from\nthe sky and draws water and energy from me.
Because of that, I cannot bloom in season...
Hm?\n...I can't get rid of that by myself.
But there is a way to remove that.\nPour a potion on my root and that draws the\npotion with water. Then, that gets away in pain.
So... Could you get the potion for me?\nI'll do something in return.
Thank you! I really appreciate your help...\nThe potion is called Parasiverto. But...\nI don't know the ingredients and how to make it...
Huh? Where are the flowers?\nWhat's going on?
Hey! Do you know anything about this?
Oh? You are...\nThe adventurer we met at Elkat Camp, right?\nIt's been a long time! How have you been?
They are the Support Caravan for Adventurers.\nYou met them when you started your adventure.
Looks like they can't see Sherry...
Ah, you were with us when we were attacked\nby the dragon... We had hard time after that.\nOur equipment were burned and it flew away...
Ha ha, what's past is past.\nLet's just be glad we met again...
You came to enjoy Hanami?\n...Huh? Haven't you heard of Hanami?!\nIt's to go on a spree under cherry blossoms!
Tenert, that's a bit wrong.
But we can't start without cherry blossoms.\nDo you know what has happened to this tree?
What?!\nThe crystal on the tree is ripping off water and\nenergy from it?!
Who said that?\n...The spirit of this tree?! Ha ha ha!\nYou hit your head hard somewhere, didn't you?
Wait. The elf magi told us about spirits, right?\nWe just cannot recognize them. They exist...
So, how can the spirit get well and bloom?
You told them that Parasiverto might work but\nyou didn't know the ingredients and how to make.
Parasiverto? Ha ha!\nIt's a famous potion for pest control.\nIt's used in my hometown.
Well, it's hard to get the ingredients.\nBut I doubt that the spirit says such a...
...Then, if we get the ingredients, even you can\ncreate that, right?
Huh? Well, yea. I often watched the old guys\ncreate the potion.\nHey, Tenert. Don't say you believe that story.
This adventurer knows nothing about this world.\nHow can such a person say the name of the potion?
Someone might have told about the...
Shut up!\nI believe this adventurer!
What?!
And... I just wanna enjoy Hanami!\nI try anything so the tree can be in full bloom!!
For your own good?!
I'm in!\nThe adventurer doesn't look like telling a lie.
Agh! This is what is wrong with this caravan!
Wow! Thanks for helping me everybody!!
...So, these are the ingredients of Parasiverto.\nGot it? The problem is...\nWe need to hunt monsters.
The monsters are very strong and that's why it's\nhard to get the ingredients.\nKeep your guard up, or you'll be slashed.
Hmm... I got it.\nAdventurer, we'll find the den of each monster,\nso come after us later.
...Which one to hunt first? It's up to you.\nWe'll start the hunt when you reach there.\nAlright, everyone! Stay alert!
Thanks in advance.\nSounds like you need to fight strong monsters...\nPlease come back safe...
Welcome back!\nThey said you've collected the ingredients but...\nI was worrying about you till now.
What are you doing alone?\nWell, I'm glad to see you're safe.\nLet me check the ingredients... Great, all set.
It's your turn, Virgo.\nCreate Paradisert or something.
Parasiverto.\nGive me the ingredients.
Hey, here you are. This is Parasiverto.\nHuh? How to use?\nJust pour it on the root.
A plant absorbs the potion with water and destroy\nthe insects. Give it a try.
He's kind at heart.\nHe was saying it was too much of a bother but...\nhe created the potion for us.
What are you doin' alone again?\nHey, pour the potion right now.\nThe spirit must be waiting for it.
Look! The crystal got away!!\nThe spirit was right! The potion really works!
Finally, I can bloom...\nAdventurer, I really appreciate your...\nWhoa?!
Ugggrrrr!! M-My bodyyyy!!\nMy body's burrrninggg! Agggrrhhh!!
No! What happened?!
I-It's going mad in pain!
Y-You used the potion, didn't you?!\nBe prepaaarrred!!
So, this was sapping the tree!\nAlright. Take it down and enjoy Hanami!\nGuys! Prepare for the battle!
Uggg.... Y-You... You think it's over, huh...?\nHow optimistic... The crystal will fall one after\nanother... Gwa ha ha! Ug...
Adventurer, everyone, thank you so much.\nPlease enjoy watching my full bloom!!
Amazing...
How beautiful...\nIt has such beautiful flowers...
Great! Let Hanami begin!! Party time!\nHey, adventurer. What are you doing?\nYou join us! Right? Virgo? Libera?
Um...What's up with that face?
I'm concerned about the last word...\nThe crystal will fall one after another...
...Unfortunately, it is true.\nThe crystal stuck to me many times...
I was saved by the people who could communicate\nwith me like you but...\nThere's no guarantee that I will be saved again...
What?! It's happening again and again?\nWhy didn't you say that earlier?!\nWell yea. We can't talk with the spirit...
But now! We understood your situation.\nWe will protect you from now on!!
We can never leave such a beautiful tree as it is.\nAdventurer, you can help us when you have time,\nright?
Hmph, the guys here are so easy to deal with.
Alright!! Let's get back to Hanami!\nEveryone! Prepare for the party!!
[ff6464]Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.[ffffff]\nPlease talk to Sherry to get the reward.
Oh! Adventurer! You came just at the right time...\nYes... That happened again. I'm sorry but could\nyou get the ingredients of Parasiverto again?
I'd like to do something in return.\nSo, please help me...
Hey! You are here!
It's caravan members!\nYou really came to see me?!
I knew it.\nWe came to check if it's safe.
We've gotta get rid of the crystal.\nVirgo?
Alright, alright. I'm ready.\nGive me the ingredients and I can create it.
Wow! Everyone, thank you so much!
Alright, adventurer.\nYou know the ingredients, right?\nWe'll go to the den of the monsters. Come later.
...Which one to hunt first? I’ll leave it to you.\nGot it?\nAlright, guys! Keep your guard up!
Thanks in advance.\nI pray for your safety...
Welcome back!\nI knew you're strong but I was worried about you\ntill you come back. I'm glad to see you're safe...
Looks like there's nothing we need to worry\nabout you.\nAre the ingredients all set?
Okay, Virgo.\nCreate Parallelvert or something.
Parasiverto.\nHow many times do I have to tell you, Tenert?
Here you are.\nI'll leave the rest to you.
Please be careful...\nAfter you pour the potion, the monster will break\nout from the crystal...
Guys, prepare for the battle.\nReady? Alright. Adventurer, pour the potion.\nYou shouldn't be off guard either, okay?
It got off!!
Watch out! It's coming!!
Ugggrrraaah! My body's burning!!\nArrrgghhhh!
It appeared!
I-It's really horrible!
Y-You did that to me?!\nI will get you down!!
Everyone, the battle begins!!
Ugg... D-Don't think you won...\nWe will keep coming down from the sky...\nHa ha ha...! Ugh!
Adventurer, everyone!\nI really appreciate your help!\nPlease watch my full bloom!
Hmm...\nIt's great no matter when it's in full bloom...
It's so beautiful...\nIt looks like as if it was saying thank you to us.
Hey! Stupid crystals!! Come if you want!\nWe will get rid of you all!!\nRight, guys?
Yea.\nAnd I'm sure the adventurer will give us a hand.
Heh, such good-natured guys.
Adventurer, everyone... Thanks.\nI hope you can save me again.
Alright! Party time! Let's enjoy!\nCome on, adventurer! Join us!\nEveryone! Prepare for the party!!
[ff6464]Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.[ffffff]\nPlease talk to Sherry to get the reward.
Is everything okay? ...I see.\nI'm sorry for getting you involved in trouble...\nPlease be careful when fighting the monsters.
Oh, adventurer.\nThanks to your help, I can bloom all the flowers.\nI can't say thank you enough.
I never know when the crystals fall on me but...\nI'd like to devote myself to show my flowers to\neveryone here. Please watch me!
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Hey! It's you!! Have a seat here and drink.\nThe flowers bloomed thanks to your help.\nYou must enjoy watching them, right?
It's really wonderful...\nWe'll take down the crystal any number of times\nso we can enjoy this, right? Ha ha! Drink! Drink!
Are you having fun?\nIf you couldn't talk with the spirit of this tree,\nwe would have just passed through here.
Anyway, what are the monsters in the crystals?\nWe don't know where it's coming down from...\nTell me if you find similar monsters.
Hey, friend... of justice.\nThanks to your help, I've worked with no pay.\nI'm too tired.
Meh. I didn't wanna do something for free.\nBut... I like this scenery.\nYea. I kinda love it...
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
Go back to Sofya City?
Yes
No
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Viscum!!
Oh! How nice of you to come to see me again!!\nI'm so happy to have many visitors today.\nLook, over there!
Hey, you came to watch the cherry blossoms, huh?\nWe were planning to enjoy Hanami within peak\nbloom but I've got separated from the members.
I thought this was the best place to enjoy Hanami\nand they would come to here.\nBut looks like they haven't arrived yet.
By the way, is she here? I mean the spirit of\nthe Sakura tree. Oh, I see.\nI can't see her at all. What a pity...
Well, it's really great.\nWe've been worried if the tree is infested by\nthe crystal monster again.
So, I brought Parasiverto the infest repellent\njust in case but... Looks like I don't need it.
Thanks, Mr. Virgo.\nI might need it...
Hm? What's wrong?
We might need Parasiverto? Why?\nLook, it's blooming really nicely.\nIs something wrong with...
Thanks to your help, I'm blooming as I used to be.\nBut, I can't contact [ffff64]Cersier[ffffff] my elder sister\nrecently...
Cersier is a spirit of Sakura tree who blooms\nsplendid Yozakura in the night region. But she\nwon't respond to my telepathy from a few days ago.
I'm afraid that she might be attacked by monsters\nsomething like the one that stuck to me...\nEven if that's true, I can't do anything alone...
So... Could you go to see Cersier with me?\nI'd like you to help her if she's in trouble...
I see... Personally, I don't want get involved\nin trouble. But I'll give you a hand if I can\nhelp the spirit with my Parasiverto.
Thank you so much!\nI don't know how to say thank you enough...\nNow, let's hurry!
Wait. I'll leave some signs with magic since\nwe need to go to another place. Let me see...\nAlright, that should do it. Let's go!
Okay? Let's go.\nWatch your step, please.
Hey! You're here just as I thought. It's the best\nplace to enjoy Hanami, isn't it? I came first cuz\nlast time Virgo did, but looks like I’m too early.
Anyway,it's beautiful indeed. I guess it's safe.\nThen I have nothing to do for a while, so It'll\nbe nice to stay here and enjoy Hanami...
Oh! I'm so glad to see you again!!
Mr. Tenert, I appreciate that you come often to\nprotect me. I've been safe thanks to your help.
Well, It was my idea to patrol...\nBut if you don't have problems now, I'd like to\nlook around Sakuras in other worlds.
Oh! Then, the houseboat should be the best way.\nI'll guide you. Please follow me...
What? A houseboat? Should be fun to enjoy Hanami\non a boat! Let's go now!! ...Huh?\nLibera and Virgo? I'll pick 'em up later.
Don't even know where you are but thanks for\nguiding us, the Sakura fairies.
Hey, long time no see!
How is it going? Glad to hear that!\nYes...? Tenert? Oh, he said his lower back hurts,\nso I left him at Elkat Camp.
He was super annoyed when I told him I'm going to\nHanami and said I should be in his shoes too\nsometimes.
So mean! But he seems to be gone and enjoying\nhimself alone occasionally, so let this be a\nlesson to him. Hihihi...
So many people came today. Thank you!
Since you guys all came today, let me take you to\na place you've never seen before.
Oh, are the sakura tree spirits here?\nWhat... A place we've never seen? That's great!
Mmm, too bad the sakura spirits are still invisible\nto us. We have so many questions about this\nworld...
We're very sorry for not being able to even say\nthank you although they always come to check our\nsafety. Please tell them to enjoy today instead...
Sorry, we don't know where you are, but it's all\nright since you always let us enjoy your sakura\nwhenever we come here.
Dear spirits of sakura tree, please show us the\nplace we've never seen before.
Ah? We can still see the spirits here...\nI see, it's because of Celesa's power.\nIt drives me nuts when I can't see them...
Thank you everyone for setting Celesa free.\nThanks to you, the day region of the sakura world\nremains peaceful.
Don't mention it. I'm glad everyone's okay.
Aight, we have spent quite some time here.\nTime to go back, otherwise Tenert might throw a\ntantrum. We're off.
It seems that various monsters are still lurking\nout there...We'll come to patrol this place when\nwe can, you too please.
If a powerful enemy appears, call for help.\nEverything's just like what Tenert decided before,\nokay. Aight, see ya...
Thank you too, adventurer. Thanks to you,\neverything in the day region of the sakura world is\nfine. It's nothing special, but please take it...
Please come back soon. Next time with Tenert too.\nLet's throw a fun feast!\nWe'll be waiting for you here with Celesa.
Oh wow...so it's a place like this...amazing.\nSeems to have a lot of interesting stuff...\nTee hee hee...
Oh! You're here!\nAnd...who do we have here?
Oh! Aren't you Tenert from the Support Caravan?\nLong time no see! Why are you here tho?
Hmm? Wait...you're...aha, the caravan I ran into\nmany times before...you're P-pe, Pel...what was\nyour name again? Anyhow, you've helped me before.
Yeah, we ran into each other a lot since we all\ntravel here and there. The caravans are my\nvaluable customers since they buy a lot from me...
But how could you really forget my name?\nPelulu, it's Pelulu. Never forget it again, okay?\nAnyway, where are the other two?
You mean Libera and Virgo? They've got stuff\nto do, so they're running a bit late.\nThey'll come as soon as they're done...
After all, this place is still the best hanami\nspot.
I'm so glad that you said so.
Oops...I forgot that Tenert can't see me now...
Hmm, I can't see it, but I know there's something\nhere, isn't it? And I don't think Tenert is lying\neither...But, why only you can see them?
If I'm not mistaken, I only can't see them here,\nbut if it's other hanami spots, I'd be able to see\nthem.
Wait, what? Where's it?!
Take me there too!\nCuz it's you, I know you wouldn't say no, right?!\nI might find something rare that I can sell...!
Oh, what do we do now Cersier...\nShall we take them to your place?
But it's quiet and nice here. I don't feel like\nmoving to a noisy place...Besides, this girl seems\ndifficult to handle.
I don't know but it feels like somebody just said\nsomething bad about me.
Perhaps you're right, but...\nI think it'll be fine if it's Caylass'.
What...? You mean Caylass' place?\nThe place where the Twilight Sakura Castle is?
Just like Celesa, the ruler of the Sakura Castle\nin the day region that you helped before, there's\nalso a ruler in the night region called Caylass.
What...? No, I haven't heard of the castle in the\nnight region of the sakura world getting attacked.\nBut, I think we should go and see for ourselves.
If it's okay, I suggest that you do the hanami\nthere this time...
Oh! So it's a place that Libera and Virgo have\nnever been to either?! Aight, I'll be the first to\ncheck it out then. Take me there!
And of course I'm coming too!\nI might be able to do some good business there!
Er...it's fine, right?\nI believe nothing is happening there because\nusually it's Caylass that rocks the boat.
Maybe, I guess so...\nThere's no way she would harm visitors...
I need you to say that with more confidence,\nCersier!
So? Where should we go from here?
S-sorry.\nThis way please...
Oh! I remember you two are from the Support\nCaravan for Adventurers.\nAre you here for Hanami too?
Yeah, we just got here too. It's good that you\nguys are also here cuz you know, we can't\ncommunicate with the sakura tree spirits.
Tenert told us that he would be waiting here\nthough...Oh, dear spirits, do you know where he\nwent?
Tenert was also here before, but...
Caylass, the ruler of the\nTwilight Sakura Castle abducte...\ninvited him to the night sakura world for a drink.
A-a drink? By the way, what does the booze in this\nworld look like?
Ooh, you've never tried sakura liqueur before?
I think Tenert must be being forced...Ahem, I mean\nhe must be drinking it now with Caylass in\nthe castle. Let's go there!
Anyway, we've been to the night sakura world\nbefore, but not the castle.
Well, please guide us then!
What about you guys?
If I bring home some liqueur from this world, I\nthink I can sell it at a whopping price...Tehee ♪\nOf course I'm in! Let's go together!!
Okay, let me show you the way...
You know this place is always quiet.\nThere really seems to be no one here this time...
Usually Sherry and Cersier would greet you...
Wait, there's no sign of anyone here...\nWhere are Sherry and Cersier?\nHm...
Oh, I remember the ruler of of the castle in the\nday region. Her name's Celesa, right...?\nMaybe they went to her castle...Let's go there!
